question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing left back, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing center midfielder, and Eve is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Finally, Eve and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) left back
(C) benchwarmer
(D) center midfielder
(E) striker
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: fullback | left back | benchwarmer | center midfielder | striker
1. Eve ↔ Bob: fullback | striker | benchwarmer | center midfielder | left back
2. Dave ↔ Bob: fullback | center midfielder | benchwarmer | striker | left back
3. Dave ↔ Alice: striker | center midfielder | benchwarmer | fullback | left back
4. Eve ↔ Bob: striker | left back | benchwarmer | fullback | center midfielder
5. Eve ↔ Bob: striker | center midfielder | benchwarmer | fullback | left back
Eve is playing left back, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
